title: Lubrication Pump Current — Elevated
description: Pump current P042 = {val} A, {val2}% above baseline. Pump running but increased load detected.
probable_cause: Increased oil viscosity (cold start), partial line restriction.
diagnostic_steps: Confirm oil grade matches viscosity specification
remedy: Allow machine to warm up. Monitor for 30 minutes.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
